title: Heat loss of an insulated pipe per metre: closed form (steady radial conduction in series + outside film) with the ht 1.2.0 reference example
source: S19 ht 1.2.0 (PyPI, MIT, Caleb Bell), ht/conduction.py cylindrical_heat_transfer docstring example (Bergman et al., Introduction to Heat Transfer, 6th ed.)
formula: Q' = (Ti - To) / [ ln(D1/D0)/(2 pi k_steel) + ln(D2/D1)/(2 pi k_ins) + 1/(h_o pi D2) + 1/(h_i pi D0) ]

inputs.comment: NPS 3 Sch 40 steel (ID 77.93 mm, wall 5.49 mm) with 50 mm insulation

check: re-derived independently in the scratchpad from the formula above: 73.12000884 W/m (difference 1e-10); docstring value and own derivation agree
grade: A (reference code example + independent closed-form recomputation)
